import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features (they're not direct causes)
    non_derived_mask = [t != 'derived' for t in feats.types]
    ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in range(len(feats.ids)) if non_derived_mask[i]]
    types = [feats.types[i] for i in range(len(feats.types)) if non_derived_mask[i]]
    x = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in ids]]
    
    # Calculate effect sizes (difference in means)
    y = feats.y
    means_1 = np.mean(x[y == 1], axis=0)
    means_0 = np.mean(x[y == 0], axis=0)
    effect_sizes = np.abs(means_1 - means_0)
    
    # Sort by effect size
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1]
    top_ids = [ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check correlation matrix to avoid near-duplicates
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(x.T)
    selected = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(top_ids):
        is_duplicate = any(
            abs(corr_matrix[feats.column(fid), feats.column(selected_fid)]) > 0.6 
            for selected_fid in selected
        )
        if not is_duplicate:
            selected.append(fid)
    
    # Build regression components
    drivers = tuple(selected)
    columns = tuple(selected)  # Only use selected drivers
    
    # Add interaction terms for top features
    products = []
    if len(selected) >= 2:
        # Add strongest interaction term
        products = [(selected[0], selected[1])]
    
    # Weighted score using top feature
    loadings = {fid: effect_sizes[sorted_indices[i]] 
                for i, fid in enumerate(selected)}
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
